tasks.short: Create a checked spending or debt-management plan

steps.what: Enter and reconcile the client's actual income, debts, payment terms and expenses against supplied records
inputs: client-supplied financial records
existing verified client financial assessment if available
outputs: checked financial input table with source references

steps.what: Agree financial goals and feasible spending or debt-plan assumptions with the client
inputs: checked financial input table with source references
client's goals and practical constraints
outputs: client-discussed goals and counselor-selected plan assumptions

steps.what: Calculate the spending and repayment schedules from the checked inputs and selected assumptions
inputs: checked financial input table with source references
client-discussed goals and counselor-selected plan assumptions

steps.what: Lay out the calculated schedules and selected assumptions in the client plan template
inputs: calculated cash-flow and repayment schedules
client-discussed goals and counselor-selected plan assumptions
outputs: complete plan draft with explicit assumptions

steps.what: Review the completed plan's calculations, affordability and assumptions and select the final plan
inputs: complete plan draft with explicit assumptions
checked financial input table with source references
outputs: checked final spending or debt-management plan

steps.what: Save the checked final plan in the same client document store
inputs: checked final spending or debt-management plan

tasks.design: Test existing {SPREADSHEET} formulas and templates first, then fill the plan in {DOCS} deterministically from checked inputs and counselor-selected assumptions. The counselor retains goal discussion, affordability judgement and final checking; saving the checked plan neither enrolls the client nor contacts creditors.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated schedule calculations and layout take effort separate from counseling.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated formulas and document templates can handle arithmetic and layout without model judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A mathematically balanced plan may not be feasible for the client's life.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize unstable income, missing expenses and unrealistic assumptions.

ambition.what: Compare a second counselor-selected income-interruption scenario before choosing the plan.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheet formulas and fixed templates can calculate and present budgets from checked inputs; debt advice remains professional judgement.

assumptions: Boundary ends at creation and storage of a plan. No creditor send, enrollment, payment instruction, loan decision or legal filing is performed.

Counselor captures and verifies client ID, income amount and period, expense category and period, debt balance, agreed interest and payment terms, and source date in s1. Goals and scenario assumptions are supplied in s2; missing or disputed terms stop calculation pending manual resolution.

Native formulas and templates first. No model performs arithmetic. The shares and potential removal of calculation/layout effort are unmeasured scenarios; if formulas already do the work, there is no repeated human baseline to remove.

Gross 35 minus 2 upkeep leaves 33 net. Final checking is existing plan quality work after the complete draft exists; same-store save is 1% fully retained. Resolve financial-input capture ownership with the separate assessment task at roll-up.
unknowns: Existing spreadsheet automation and actual manual calculation effort
research_questions: Can templates remove repeated arithmetic and layout while retaining a feasible, traceable plan?

already_counted.description: Review the completed plan and its affordability

incremental.description: Maintain tested formulas, plan templates and failure cases

approvals.approved_version: checked final plan from s5; any changed assumption or figure requires renewed check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where formulas and templates already remove repeated work; up to 25% if exceptions reduce the central 33% net scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess the client's overall financial situation

steps.what: Review income, assets, debts, expenses, credit reports and other supplied financial information against their sources
inputs: client-authorized financial records and credit reports

loop.purpose: Extract candidate financial facts from unstructured records for review
loop.input: Client-authorized financial documents with source identifiers
loop.output: Candidate amounts, periods, debt terms and source locations; missing fields marked unknown
loop.check: Counselor checks each fact against source, period, sign, account holder and any contradictory record; totals are independently calculated
loop.stop: One extraction pass; missing or conflicting facts require manual source review
loop.why_not_simpler: Native structured exports are used first; remaining documents may express periods and debt terms in prose

steps.what: Clarify missing or inconsistent financial information with the client
inputs: source-checked financial facts and discrepancies
client's clarifications
outputs: clarified financial position and unresolved gaps

steps.what: Assess the overall financial situation including commitments, liquidity, instability and unresolved uncertainty
inputs: clarified financial position and unresolved gaps

tasks.design: Test structured exports and native document views before extracting remaining prose records into candidate facts in {SPREADSHEET}. The counselor verifies sources, resolves gaps with the client and makes the overall assessment; no score or eligibility decision is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mixed documents make source review repetitive.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded extraction can locate candidate facts without deciding what they mean for the client.
tasks.still_hard: Documents can omit informal debts or unstable future expenses.
tasks.human_edge: Find contradictions and understand what the records do not show.

ambition.what: No automatic client eligibility or creditworthiness service.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-9; authorized client records and applicable consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded document extraction can assist factual source review but requires checks on amounts, periods and ownership.

assumptions: Boundary is financial review and assessment, not creating a separate report or deciding credit. No record commit or send is introduced.

Client supplies actual authorized records; candidate fields are produced within s1 and checked there. Missing documents remain unknown and are clarified in s2; neither structured intake nor extraction correction is free.
Native exports first; no model arithmetic. Shares are provisional scenarios. Gross 8 minus 1 upkeep leaves 7 net. Common fact capture with plan creation must receive one roll-up owner.
unknowns: Document mix and actual extraction correction effort
research_questions: Does extraction reduce total source-review effort after period and contradiction checks?

already_counted.description: Verify extracted candidate facts against sources

incremental.description: Review recurring extraction errors and document changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when manual checking offsets extraction; up to 4% if benefit is below central 7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend feasible strategies for the client's goals

steps.what: Consult the existing financial assessment and approved information about available debt and budgeting routes
inputs: existing client financial assessment and goals
locally approved strategy references
outputs: source-checked client context and route information

steps.what: Weigh suitable borrowing, budget adjustment, debt-management or specialist insolvency routes against the client's actual goals and situation
inputs: source-checked client context and route information
outputs: counselor-selected strategy and reasons, including referral where needed

steps.what: Recommend the selected strategy to the client and explain tradeoffs and questions requiring specialist advice
inputs: counselor-selected strategy and reasons, including referral where needed
client's questions
outputs: explained recommendation and clarified client understanding

tasks.design: Provide native saved reference views in {DOCS} for locally approved strategy information beside the existing client assessment. The counselor selects and explains the recommendation; software does not recommend bankruptcy, approve borrowing or enroll anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding applicable reference information can interrupt strategy assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference indexing can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: A technically available option can be unsuitable for the client's circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Weigh consequences, uncertainty and the client's practical goals.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference indexing can assist retrieval while individualized debt-strategy recommendations require professional judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is choosing and verbally recommending a strategy. No separate written report, referral send, filing, enrollment or lender decision is performed.

Counselor supplies an existing verified assessment; reference owner supplies locally approved documents with version and scope. If facts are incomplete, manual clarification remains necessary and no strategy is inferred.
Native references first. No current legal, loan eligibility or insolvency rule is asserted here. Shares are provisional; gross 1.5 minus 0.3 upkeep yields 1.2 net.
unknowns: Local scope of counselor advice and referral requirements
research_questions: Can native reference indexing save lookup while preserving counselor responsibility and appropriate referral?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if references are already available; up to 0.8% with smaller retrieval gains than central 1.2% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer a client's financial inquiry by email

steps.what: Read the client's email inquiry and identify the question and relevant client context
inputs: client inquiry
existing client record
outputs: clarified inquiry scope and relevant context

steps.what: Find the applicable approved information and confirm whether the question needs individualized or specialist advice
inputs: clarified inquiry scope and relevant context
approved financial information
outputs: selected source passages and counselor's response direction

steps.what: Draft the response from the selected source passages and counselor's response direction
inputs: selected source passages and counselor's response direction
clarified inquiry scope and relevant context

loop.purpose: Draft a clear reply from selected approved information
loop.input: Client question, selected passages and counselor's answer direction
loop.output: Draft with source references and unresolved questions
loop.check: Counselor verifies each assertion, relevance, limitations and client context; no invented eligibility, rates or legal outcome
loop.stop: One redraft then manual reply; uncertain individualized recommendations stay with counselor
loop.why_not_simpler: Saved replies are tested first, but a mixed question may require source-grounded phrasing

steps.what: Check the complete reply for suitability, accuracy and recipient and select the final response
inputs: complete financial-inquiry reply draft
selected source passages and counselor's response direction
outputs: checked final client reply and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final financial-inquiry reply to the client
inputs: checked final client reply and recipient

tasks.design: Use native source indexing in {DOCS} and saved replies in {EMAIL} before a bounded draft from counselor-selected sources. The counselor checks the complete financial reply and its recipient before sending the exact version; no client decision or transaction is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source lookup and phrasing take time alongside individualized advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reply tools and bounded source-grounded drafting can assist composition.
tasks.still_hard: A general explanation can be mistaken for a recommendation suitable for this client.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when to clarify, personalize or refer rather than provide a generic answer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-grounded reply drafting can assist financial correspondence while suitability and send authority remain human.

assumptions: Model the email route expressly named in the statement; live calls are not claimed faster. Boundary includes question reading, source lookup, drafting, final check and external send.

Client supplies the actual inquiry, counselor supplies response direction, and reference owners supply approved documents with versions. Missing facts trigger clarification or referral, not inferred financial advice.
Native saved replies first. Shares are provisional scenarios; final checking includes existing suitability review rather than adding an approval role. The short send is 1% fully retained.
Gross 21 minus 1 upkeep leaves 20 net. Any edit to reply or recipient after s4 invalidates the gate.
unknowns: Email share of inquiries and current saved-reply coverage
research_questions: Does source-grounded drafting reduce total reply effort without making unsupported personalized recommendations?

already_counted.description: Draft correction and final response suitability review

incremental.description: Maintain saved replies and review recurring drafting defects

approvals.approved_version: checked final reply and recipient from s4; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero for highly individualized questions or effective existing saved replies; up to 15% when correction reduces central 20% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Counselors retain assessment and advice authority; checked calculation and drafting tools reduce repeated arithmetic, layout and phrasing.
skills_to_grow: Validate financial input periods and source ownership
Check formula scenarios and source-grounded replies
role.ambitious_version: Compare an additional realistic budget scenario while keeping individualized debt advice with the counselor.
